03 / SAFETY BY DESIGN

A safer journey is
part of the route.

Safety isn’t a separate feature. Safar evaluates the trip before pickup and stays attentive until everyone arrives.

  • Safer pickup suggestionsPrefer well-lit, legal, easy-to-find meeting points.
  • Unexpected change detectionFlag unusual route deviations or prolonged stops.
  • Privacy-first matchingHide exact destinations and personal contact details until consent.
04 / THE BIGGER JOURNEY

Less traffic begins
with fewer empty seats.

Safar aims to make shared travel feel like the obvious choice: economical enough to matter, predictable enough to trust, and convenient enough to repeat.
